name: @mailforge/documentation
description: Interactive documentation portal for the MailForge email framework

scripts.dev: node -e 'import("node:http").then(h => h.createServer((req, res) => { import("node:fs").then(fs => fs.readFile("./index.html", (err, data) => { res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }); res.end(data); })); }).listen(3333, () => console.log("Documentation server running at http://localhost:3333")))'
